description: Priya Sharma sends a peer-to-peer professional email to David Chen at First Community Bank, offering to compare insurance-sector disruption data (policy cancellation trends, car ownership decline, liability structure shifts from personal to corporate fleet) with his lending-side perspective. She frames it as a stakeholder conversation about Millfield's economic transition, not a job inquiry. She requests a 30-minute call.
expected_outcome: David Chen may respond positively — he has been publicly engaged on community economic transition data and a risk-data peer conversation costs him little. Even if he does not respond immediately, Priya has made herself visible to a financial sector contact in a professional, low-risk way. Long-term: potential reference, informational interview, or data-sharing relationship that strengthens her pivot narrative.
